{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check missing values in flipper_length_mm specifically
print(f'Missing values in flipper_length_mm: {penguins["flipper_length_mm"].isnull().sum()}')

# Drop rows with missing flipper length
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
mean_flipper_by_species_sorted = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Display results
print(mean_flipper_by_species_sorted)

# Get the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_species = mean_flipper_by_species_sorted.iloc[0]['species']
print(f'Highest mean flipper length species: {highest_species}')"}
